owner_review.coverage: TCR1–TCR21 and SC1–SC24 read and derived in full: exact complete residual; actual force/score pairing; cutoff source and Gram errors; finite invertibility; original uncut metric and two-sided signed window; sharper least-squares coefficient and singular-value bound; exact source stereographic coordinates, probability-Haar factor and original radius-two metric; actual marginal and exact moment threshold; full rational ordered action and full-density counterexample; explicit state and parameter maps. SC18–SC24 full orbit-integral proof, all four-link tensor constants and contractions, all five rational action expectations, original path cancellation, score-weighted extension and complete Pauli/staple force receiver.
owner_review.strengthening: Projection orthogonality improves cutoff amplitude error to O(a^(rho-3)*sqrt(log(1/a))). Direct singular-value perturbation permits rho>9/2 for an o(a^(3/2)) cutoff amplitude without the coarse Gram loss. The interacting residual is retained. SC19 gives the exact actual-state four-link gauge tensor with factor1/128. SC21 evaluates every signed rational action term in terms of the original plaquette mean; SC22 evaluates their original-path mean limits. SC23 retains every bounded gauge-invariant multiplier, including G_e and J_X. SC24 evaluates the force contraction in original loop moments.
owner_review.correction: The printed O(g^2) plaquette-action remainder in arXiv2401.10507v4 label approxdens omits a cubic group term yielding an O(g) action term. SC8–SC15 prove an exact full-density counterexample and rational replacement. This does not disprove the main scaling theorem. Actual unfixed-link stereographic moments diverge at order three and above, so polynomial high-moment substitution cannot control this vacuum.
owner_review.limitations: No original interacting residual or signed window value has been evaluated. State comparison is finite-regulator and not uniform. Reconstruction, interacting continuum identification, global smoothness and the no-gap endpoint remain unproved.
